name: odin-trainer
description: Dark-wave muscle-memory trainer for the Odin programming language — drill book-aligned code snippets, track reps per section until trained.

scripts.build:linux: node scripts/build-embedded.mjs && mkdir -p bin/linux-x64 && bun build --compile server/index.js --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/linux-x64/odin-trainer
scripts.build: npm run curriculum && npm run build:linux
